auditDescription: Review actions visible to this organization. The default range is the last 30 days.
auditDetailDescription: This record shows the stored structured audit facts.
auditEmpty: No audit records found for this date range.
auditError: Could not load audit records. Check your access or try again later.
auditInvalidDateRange: The start date must not be after the end date.
auditRangeTooLong: The date range cannot exceed 90 days.
deleteRoleDescription: Confirm deletion of “{{role}}”. Remove all member and active invitation references first.
editRoleDescription: Confirm permission changes for “{{role}}”. They apply to affected members on their next request.
inviteDescription: Send an invitation email. The recipient must verify email before accepting.
leaveDescription: You will lose access to this organization. Your account and memberships in other organizations will remain.
membershipChanged: Member permissions have changed. Close this dialog, review the current members, and try again.
name: Organization name
ownershipHint: To transfer ownership, first promote another existing member to owner. After that succeeds, you may change your role or leave. At least one owner must remain.
platformAuditDescription: Review approved operations across organizations. Enter a purpose for each investigation; the default range is the last 30 days, with a maximum of 90 days.
platformAuditDetailDescription: This access uses the current investigation purpose and is recorded in the audit log.
platformAuditEnterPurpose: Enter a purpose and apply filters to load audit records.
platformAuditInvalid: Enter a valid value and a date range of at most 90 days ending no later than now.
platformDangerDescription: Target: {{name}} ({{slug}}). Enter the organization slug and a reason. The internal reason is not shown to tenants.
platformLatestState: Latest status: {{status}}, version {{version}}. Review it before confirming again.
platformNoChange: The organization is already in the target state. No change was made.
platformReadPurposeInvalid: Enter a purpose between 1 and 500 characters.
platformResultUnknown: The operation result is unconfirmed. Retrying sends the same request. Do not start another operation.
platformReviewLatest: Review and confirm the latest state
platformSensitiveDescription: Enter the purpose of this access. A successful read is recorded in the audit log.
platformSensitiveReadFailed: Could not read the email. Your purpose is preserved; try again.
platformSettingsDescription: Manage the platform language and view the deployment summary.
platformSettingsInheritance: Changes apply to later language inheritance. Personal and organization preferences remain unchanged.
platformSettingsReadOnly: Your platform auditor role can view these settings.
platformSettingsReload: Discard draft and reload latest settings
platformSlugInvalid: Enter the exact target organization slug.
platformSmtpConfigurationHint: Configuration status does not confirm delivery or service availability.
platformUsersSearch: Search name, user ID or masked email
platformUsersSearchInvalid: Search must be at most 200 characters.
roleChanged: The role or its references changed. Close this dialog and confirm again.
roleInUse: This role is referenced by {{memberCount}} members and {{invitationCount}} active invitations. Remove the references first.
roleKeyDescription: Use 3–48 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. Keys beginning with platform are reserved. The key cannot be changed later.
roleNameAlreadyTaken: This role key is already in use in this organization.
roleNameInvalid: Enter a valid role key. Reserved names and keys beginning with platform are not allowed.
rolePermissionDenied: One or more selected permissions cannot be delegated.
rolesDescription: View built-in and custom roles, and create a custom role.
rolesEmpty: No custom roles have been created.
slugHint: A unique identifier, for example my-team.
smtpAcceptanceNotice: SMTP acceptance does not confirm delivery to the inbox.
storagePolicyDescription: View capacity usage and configure this organization’s quota and retention periods.
storagePolicyFutureOnly: Lowering the quota keeps existing files. Retention changes apply to files trashed and versions replaced in the future.
storagePolicyInvalidDays: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 2147483647.
storagePolicyInvalidQuota: Enter a non-negative GiB value that converts exactly to a safe integer number of bytes.
storagePolicyOverQuota: This organization is over its quota. Existing files remain available; uploads that add storage are blocked.
storagePolicyReadOnly: Your platform auditor role can view this storage policy.
storagePolicyReload: Discard draft and reload latest storage policy
unavailableHint: Select another available organization, or sign out.
updateRoleDescription: Change the role of {{name}} in this organization.
